'''Bleb-Blek''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he encountered a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who seemed sick and was spouting gibberish about revenge before she ran into the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] and stole Jawa's map. Bleb-Blek tasked a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to help him find the map and the Padawan.<ref name="TOR" />
